title: Biomes o Plenty & Sway Addon
description: A special add-on developed for the Fresh & Smooth modpack.
body:
A small addon to Sway that makes all vegetation from Biomes O' Plenty react.
![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d0ab067db0a71268298808a26191aead987296a6.png)

Developed specifically for the modpack [Fresh & Smooth Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fresh-smooth).
